# coordinate

Read and follow [the canonical `coordinate` skill](../../../agent-orchestration/skills/coordinate/SKILL.md) from the pinned agent-orchestration kit (if it's missing, run `git submodule update --init agent-orchestration`). Its own links resolve beside it.

This repository's rules come first: AGENTS.md, "Agent kits", and the documents it names. Log each step in `E:\Projects\Personal\atiya-progress.log`, in the kit's line format. A coordinator keeps its registry in `E:\Projects\Personal\atiya-registry.md` (outside the repository). Keep work plans and handoffs in the session workspace or the final reply, never committed unless the owner asks; report to the owner's original main chat, and never call handed-over work complete.
